name: node_embedding_similarity
author: efd53284
description: Finds nodes whose structural position is most similar to a given node using DeepWalk-style random-walk embeddings. It generates seeded random walks on the symmetrised graph, counts node co-occurrences within a sliding window, builds a positive pointwise mutual information (PPMI) matrix, factorises it with a symmetric eigendecomposition, and ranks every other node by cosine similarity to the query node. Use it for questions such as which airports have a route profile like Chennai, which characters play a similar role in Les Miserables, or which club members resemble the instructor. Works on directed and undirected graphs, weighted or unweighted; walks use graph structure and ignore edge magnitudes. The seed parameter defaults to 0, so output is deterministic. Returns the top_k nearest nodes with cosine scores in [-1, 1], excluding the query node; result_graph_id is null.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse

top_k.description: How many similar nodes to return, ordered by decreasing similarity.

walk_length.description: Number of nodes visited by each random walk.

walks_per_node.description: Number of random walks started from every node.

window.description: Context window size used when counting co-occurrences.

seed.description: Random seed for walk generation; the same seed gives the same output.
